# selector value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:selectorValue`](gmeow-selectorValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/selectorValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The raw selector data — an SVG path string, a pixel rectangle (x,y,w,h), a fractional rectangle, a polygon coordinate list, an RLE-encoded mask string, a DICOM-SEG mask reference, or a Web [`Annotation`](../classes/gmeow-Annotation.md) fragment (xywh=...). The format is determined by [`gmeow:selectorType`](gmeow-selectorType.md). Parsing and coordinate conversion live in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
